title: GHZ is All You Need: Quantum Sensing with VISTA
summary: Quantum metrology holds the potential to enhance magnetic field sensing beyond current limits. However, in the presence of realistic noise, this advantage degrades to the Standard Quantum Limit. While recent algorithmic and variational techniques attempt to recover this scaling, they are hindered by stringent control requirements on the probe state that are infeasible in the near term, or by barren plateaus and interpretability issues inherent to black-box variational quantum circuits.
